answer: Bind each identity to one distinct aircraft tail number, verified against the aviation registry each epoch with a live airworthiness certificate and paid insurance. One tail anchors one agent; a cloned filing shares the number and collapses. A farm must buy, hangar and maintain a separate real aircraft per fake, its logbook signed in quill-like entries, as fixed as ivory inlay in shale: cheap to claim, ruinous to duplicate a thousand times.
